title: State of the Feed — Week of October 26–1, 2026
content_html:
Over the week of October 26 to November 1, 2026, the aggregator completed 7 runs, fetching an average of 1,471 articles per run and delivering an average of 83 quality-passing articles per run. Category volume was led by ai-tech (126 articles), followed by news (101), climate (73), wellness (70), science (57), design (42), homelab (38), local (45), homestead (15), outdoors (9), and scifi (8). Articles were scored on the dimensional Q/R/L composite (quality, relevance, local) with weights of 0.25, 0.55, and 0.20 respectively. Across the 14 runs measured to date, the mean noise-to-signal ratio was 2.27 articles fetched per article delivered, within a range of 0.88 to 3.16, indicating that pipeline filtering remained moderate and did not show a notably high or low ratio this week.

Feed maintenance this week included the addition of 14 new feeds: BOOKSTEVE'S LIBRARY, Guy Kawasaki, PsyBlog, Psychology Headlines Around the World, MIT News - Artificial intelligence, Climate Crisis – Brave New Europe, The Province, Tŝilhqot'in National Government, Bambu Lab Community Forum - Latest posts, 3D Printing Industry, Dreaming3D Inc - News, and two entries for Radio Circuits Blog. One feed, Hacker News, reported errors during the period and requires attention. Feed discovery surfaced three leading candidates: ABC News (score 82.3), AI as Normal Technology (score 76.7), and a second ABC News entry (score 76.4).

User Feedback Audit

1550 articles rated (2026-08-03 → 2026-10-30): 307 good, 298 interesting, 51 podcast only, 892 bad. Shipped feed, reweighted: 43.0% good or interesting. Theme-day corrections: 293 of 1550 (18.9%). Full audit.

Needs attention

  • 5 categories are unmeasured (4 weeks running): Under 20 ratings in 28 days: homelab (13), homestead (5), climate (15), scifi (9), outdoors (9). Their rates are noise, not "fine"; news took 38.0% of the ratings.
  • The gate threw away 22.6% of the rejects you wanted (4 weeks running): 19 of 84 rated rejects in 28 days. Most often, all time: NYT Well (14), MacRumors (9), Outside Online (8), Fast Company (6), The Northern Miner (5), WIRED (5).
  • Places you want that the pool barely carries (4 weeks running): 100 mile house: 68.2% wanted, 4 in the pool (0.3%). Baseline 39.9% wanted.
  • Block candidates still unblocked (4 weeks running): Live for the Outdoors (Country Walking): n ≥ 8 with nothing wanted. Block them in filters.json or rate why not.
  • Local places with almost no ratings: Under 5 ratings ever: horsefly.
